Method of Attack: HTML smuggling to deliver base64-encoded ISO archive via JavaScript blob
ISO contains VBS file that creates Registry key and runs PowerShell commands
PowerShell executes GuLoader in memory to download and run RemcosRAT malware
Use of typo-squatted domains and phishing emails to lure victims
Remote access trojan capabilities including remote command execution, screenshot capturing, keystroke logging, webcam and microphone recording
Attack Vector: HTML attachment with base64-encoded ISO file
Execution of VBS script and PowerShell commands
Indicators of Compromise: Typo-squatted domains mimicking legitimate bank competitor URLs
Base64-encoded ISO file delivered via HTML smuggling
GuLoader download URLs pointing to Dropbox and OneDrive
VBS file creating Registry keys and running PowerShell
